ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; approximately 3% high-intensity (white) pixels distributed as isolated clusters against 97% low-intensity (dark black) surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a continuous solid dark pigmentation field. High-contrast white/grey contiguous clusters are localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes. Two isolated high-contrast white pixels are visible in the lower central quadrant near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 95 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying roughly 12% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across both lobes. Left lobe trailing edge features 7 primary peaks of variable amplitude (3-10 pixels). Right lobe trailing edge features 8 primary peaks with more pronounced valleys near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge from the notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a convex sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized circular high-contrast pixel clusters consistent with barnacle colonization located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Smaller, less defined cluster on the interior right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization at both the left and right fluke tips, resulting in an irregular, high-contrast 'crusty' texture that breaks the geometric line of the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct, high-intensity white punctate marks located symmetrically near the base of the median notch.
